verdict.rationale: Kling documents its own headless access paths. It offers a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey authentication, global and China API endpoints, an advertised MCP/CLI offering, and claims of automating the entire production process. These support non-interactive automation, but coverage of the story is incomplete: the CLI appears only as a headline mention, and nothing describes running it in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands/usage, CI-pipeline integration guidance or examples (e.g., non-interactive auth via environment variables, exit codes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
